findings.title: Feature flag only enabled for explicit strategy, default case left disabled
findings.body: In createInitialDeployment() the method returns early when updateStrategy == null before enabling the rolling-updates feature. That means the parameterized runs with null (default strategy) deploy without Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES enabled while the RECREATE runs have it enabled. Per the updated docs the operator requires rolling-updates to be enabled, so the null-case test exercises an unsupported/ failing configuration, diverges from the explicit-strategy cases, and cannot validate the documented default mimic-26.1 behavior.

findings.title: setEnabledFeatures overwrites existing test features
findings.body: createInitialDeployment() calls kc.getSpec().getFeatureSpec().setEnabledFeatures(List.of(ROLLING_UPDATES key)), replacing any list already present from getTestKeycloakDeployment(true). If the base deployment enables other features, they are silently dropped, so the upgrade tests run with different feature sets than intended and can hide dependency or compatibility failures.

findings.title: Feature gate checked before CLI validation masks usage errors
findings.body: run() checks Profile.isFeatureEnabled(ROLLING_UPDATES) and exits with FEATURE_DISABLED before validateConfig(). A user who omits the required --file option and also omits --features=rolling-updates will get exit code 4 (feature disabled) instead of exit code 2 (invalid CLI option). The same ordering exists in UpdateCompatibilityMetadata. Usage validation should take precedence so scripts can distinguish mis-invocation from incompatibility, as documented in the exit-code table.
